goal: 向参观者讲清生产流程

n1.speaker: 参观者 Visitor
n1.line: Thank you for showing us around. Could you tell us how the juice is made from the beginning?
n1.lineCn: 谢谢您带我们参观。能从头讲讲果汁是怎么做出来的吗?

grammar.name: 被动语态提问
grammar.note: is made 是 be + 过去分词,强调果汁"被制作"而非谁来做。

options.text: Sure. First, the oranges are washed and peeled by machines in this room.
options.textCn: 当然。首先,橙子会在这间房里被机器清洗和去皮。
options.feedback: 用被动语态讲第一步,主动语态呢?没关系,讲解清晰。
只给一句总结,参观者完全不知道流程。
答非所问,并没有回答制作流程。

n2.speaker: 参观者 Visitor
n2.line: I see! So the oranges are cleaned by machines first. What happens after the peeling?
n2.lineCn: 原来如此!橙子先被机器清洗。去皮之后又发生什么呢?

grammar.name: be + 过去分词被动式
grammar.note: are cleaned by machines,by 引出动作执行者,是典型的被动结构。

options.text: Then the juice is squeezed out and the juice is filtered twice to remove the pulp.
options.textCn: 然后果汁被压榨出来,并且被过滤两次以去除果肉。
options.feedback: 连续使用被动语态描述压榨和过滤,流程清晰。
说了等于没说,信息量几乎为零。

n3.speaker: 参观者 Visitor
n3.line: Well, could you please break it down step by step? We are really curious about how everything is processed here.
n3.lineCn: 嗯,能请您一步一步讲吗?我们非常好奇这里的一切是怎么加工的。

grammar.name: be processed
grammar.note: everything is processed... 用被动语态表示东西"被加工"。

options.text: Of course. The fruit is first checked by hand, and then it is loaded into the washing machines.
options.textCn: 当然。水果先被人工检查,然后被装进清洗机。
options.feedback: 补充了检查环节,讲解细致起来。

options.text: It is too hard to explain.
options.feedback: 作为讲解员却拒绝讲解,参观者只能失望而归。

n4.speaker: 参观者 Visitor
n4.line: Wow, the juice is filtered twice? What is done to make it stay fresh for a long time?
n4.lineCn: 哇,果汁被过滤两次?为了让果汁长期保鲜,还要做什么呢?

grammar.name: 被动语态 What is done
grammar.note: What is done to...? 询问"被做了些什么",突出动作而非执行者。

options.text: After filtering, the juice is heated to 120 degrees and then it is put into clean bottles. The bottles are sealed immediately.
options.textCn: 过滤后,果汁被加热到 120 度,然后装进干净的瓶子。瓶子会被立刻密封。
options.feedback: 加热、装瓶、密封一气呵成,被动语态贯穿始终,流程完整。
用魔法糊弄参观者,讲解完全不合格。

n5.speaker: 参观者 Visitor
n5.line: Ha, we would really love to know the real process. Can you show us what is done in the next step?
n5.lineCn: 哈,我们真的很想知道真实的流程。能给我们看看下一步做了什么吗?

grammar.name: what is done
grammar.note: what is done in the next step 用被动语态,讲解加工步骤。

options.text: Sorry, I was not clear. The juice is poured into bottles, and then each bottle is checked by a camera.
options.textCn: 抱歉,我刚才没说清楚。果汁被倒入瓶子,然后每个瓶子都被摄像头检查。
options.feedback: 及时补救,把装瓶和质检环节讲清楚了。

options.text: It is not allowed to tell you.
options.feedback: 工厂核心环节当然可以讲,这个借口很伤参观者的心。

n6.speaker: 参观者 Visitor
n6.line: Now I understand the whole process! So finally, how is the finished juice prepared for delivery?
n6.lineCn: 现在我明白整个流程了!那最后,做好的果汁是怎么被准备发货的?

grammar.name: 被动语态 is prepared
grammar.note: be + 过去分词 prepared,表示果汁"被准备"发货,重点在动作结果。

options.text: Finally, the boxes are labeled with dates and loaded onto trucks. Then the juice is delivered to shops across the country.
options.textCn: 最后,箱子被贴上日期标签并装上卡车,然后果汁被运往全国各地的商店。
options.feedback: 从清洗到发货全程被动语态,讲解完美收官。

options.text: You do not need to know that.
options.feedback: 最后一环拒绝讲解,给参观留下遗憾。

success.speaker: 参观者 Visitor
success.line: Perfect! Now we understand how every bottle of juice is produced. Thank you for the wonderful tour!
success.lineCn: 太棒了!现在我们明白每一瓶果汁是怎么被生产出来的了。感谢这次精彩的参观!

fail1.speaker: 参观者 Visitor
fail1.line: What a pity. We came all the way here but learned nothing about the process.
fail1.lineCn: 真遗憾。我们大老远赶来,却什么流程都没学到。

fail2.speaker: 参观者 Visitor
fail2.line: Oh, I see. Well, thanks anyway. We will read about it online instead.
fail2.lineCn: 哦,好吧。不管怎样,谢谢您。我们回去上网查吧。
